official: 羽村市長等の給料等に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 市長などの期末手当の支給月数を改定
summary: 市長、副市長、教育長の期末手当の支給月数を改めます。変更後の月数は示されていません。条例は公布日に施行し、令和7年12月1日から適用します。
changes: 期末手当の支給月数を改定する

en.name: Revises the number of months for year-end allowances for the mayor, etc.
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Salaries, etc. of the Hamura City Mayor, etc.
en.summary: The number of months used to calculate year-end allowances for the mayor, deputy mayor and superintendent of education will be revised. The revised number of months is not specified. The ordinance takes effect on the date it is promulgated and applies from December 1, 2025.
changes: Revises the number of months used to calculate year-end allowances
